slides.headline: Friday 6 PM silence. Monday: «How was it?»
48 hours of silence after 5 warm days
slides.body: All week he texts every hour. But Saturday hits — and suddenly you disappear from his world.

slides.headline: You make excuses for his silence
slides.body: «He's busy», «He needs rest». But a man who truly cares takes 10 seconds to send a single text.

slides.headline: You are just a weekday routine slot
slides.body: During work hours you cure his boredom. But when real life happens on weekends, you are kept outside.

slides.headline: What he says vs what it means
slides.body:
«Off my phone on weekends» → Just not in your chat.
«Too busy» → You are not in his rest priority.
«Not a texter» → Yet texts all week.
slides.animal_metaphor: night clarity and seeing through fog

slides.headline: 3 signs you are in the waiting trap
slides.body:
1. You never know his weekend plans.
2. He never invites you out spontaneously.
3. His affection only exists during his office hours.

slides.headline: Your weekend belongs to you
slides.body: Stop being the backup plan for his workday routine. Put the phone down and take your Saturday back.

slides.headline: True interest shows in free time
slides.body: A man's true feelings are revealed when he is completely free, not when he is just killing time at work.

slides.headline: Comment WEEKEND
